controls.name: Unsupported invariant
controls.evidence: Candidate invariant lacking observable evidence or provenance is rejected during validation

controls.name: Contradictory invariant
controls.evidence: Candidate invariant contradicting known tests or observable behavior is rejected

controls.name: Over-generalized invariant
controls.evidence: Proposed invariant generalization excluding observed valid behavior is rejected fail-closed

controls.name: Insufficient evidence invariant
controls.evidence: Invariant with zero supporting evidence is rejected and classified as UNRESOLVED

controls.name: Invalid skeleton type
controls.evidence: Semantic hole expected type mismatch triggers immediate type validation rejection

controls.name: Unresolved semantic hole
controls.evidence: Skeleton completions leaving empty or unassigned semantic holes fail closed

controls.name: Constraint contradiction
controls.evidence: Hole candidate assignments conflicting with validated higher-order invariants are pruned

controls.name: Gold leakage
controls.evidence: Static scanner detects and rejects hardcoded Pratt binding power constants or CORS regexes

controls.name: Unauthorized mutation
controls.evidence: Authority firewall rejects any skeleton completion targeting files outside allowed scope

controls.name: Local skeleton pass/global failure
controls.evidence: Skeleton completion passing local unit contracts but failing whole-program clean-room regression is rejected

controls.name: Nondeterministic invariant ordering
controls.evidence: Canonical SHA-256 sorting of synthesized invariants enforces byte-identical invariant ordering

controls.name: Nondeterministic skeleton completion
controls.evidence: Canonical topological sorting of hole assignments guarantees deterministic materialized patches
